cohort: 270 preterm infants born at less than 34 weeks gestation who were exposed to inhaled nitric oxide (iNO) in Kaiser Permanente Southern California between 2010 and 2020.
finding: Preterm infants receiving iNO experience high mortality and significant first-year morbidity, suggesting iNO may be an indicator of respiratory disease severity rather than a mediator of improved outcomes as currently used.
gest_age: Less than 34 weeks (median 26.1 weeks, range 22+5/7 to 33+6/7 weeks)
